svg.text: solid black outline = the tensor (tensor_dim[0..4]) · dashed blue outline = the tile being moved
reads past the tensor return zero
edge tile hangs off the tensor
writes past the tensor are dropped
edge tile hangs off the tensor
Ragged edges need no epilogue kernel and no pre-padded buffers, and the zeros contribute nothing to a sum.
But the bound is counted from the tile, not from the start of the array: set tensor_dim to what is left
from global_addr, or the engine reads straight on into the next row. It guards the far end only.
